content.title: Oscars 2026 Recap: 'One Battle After Another' and 'Sinners' Win Big as Reunions and a Tie Keep Us Cheering
content.text: Awards season has officially come to an end with the 2026 Academy Awards! The ceremony, hosted by Conan O'Brien at Dolby Theatre on Sunday, March 15, made winners of such hit films as One Battle After Another, Sinners and KPop Demon Hunters. One Battle dominated the night with six wins, including Best Picture, Best Director and Best Adapted Screenplay for Paul Thomas Anderson, while Sinners scored a Best Actor win for Michael B. Jordan and Best Original Screenplay for Ryan Coogler. KPop Demon Hunters took home prizes for Best Animated Feature and Best Original Song. The film also had one of the most energetic moments of the night during Huntrix's performance of "Golden." Among the other big winners were Jessie Buckley for Best Actress for her performance in Hamnet and Amy Madigan for Best Supporting Actress for her turn in Weapons. And, for only the seventh time in the awards show's 98-year history, there was a tie! The Singers and Two People Exchanging Saliva both won for Best Live-Action Short. As usual, PEOPLE was right there in the middle of the action. Read on for a detailed play-by-play of the feather-filled red carpet and ceremony and behind-the-scenes details that you can't find anywhere else. See PEOPLE's coverage of the 98th Academy Awards, which aired live on ABC and Hulu on March 15. All You Need Is Love March 15, 2026 10:57 PM EDT Ewan McGregor and Nicole Kidman at the 2026 Oscars. Rob Latour/Shutterstock Before presenting One Battle After Another with the 2026 Best Picture Oscar, Nicole Kidman and Ewan McGregor enjoyed a fun little Moulin Rouge reunion in honor of the film's upcoming 25th anniversary. "Would you say you loved them?" McGregor asked Kidman of the past year in movies. "Love, you know, like, love is like oxygen." "Oh, love is a many splendid thing," Kidman responded, quoting song lyrics and recreating a sweet moment from the movie. They wrapped up the nostalgic banter by singing a few lyrics of "All You Need Is Love." Of course they weren't the only former costars to reunite tonight. In addition to them and the Bridesmaids ladies, Avengers Robert Downey Jr. and Chris Evans also assembled for the evening. 'One Battle After Another' Wins Best Picture March 15, 2026 10:43 PM EDT Paul Thomas Anderson and Sara Murphy win best picture at the 2026 Oscars. Kevin Winter/Getty One Battle After Another scored six Oscars tonight, including the top prize, best picture. As the cast and crew headed to the stage, star Teyana Taylor put Paul Thomas Anderson in a headlock. "Getting to make the is film with this cast and this crew, Paul, has already been the greatest filmmaking experience I could fathom so receiving this award is just beyond," says EP Sara Murphy. "My heart is exploding with gratitude." Paul Thomas Anderson chimed in recalling the incredible nominees at the 1975 Oscars and concluded with, "What a night, you guys. Let's have a martini." Jessie Buckley Wins for Best Actress March 15, 2026 10:36 PM EDT Jessie Buckley wins best actress at the 2026 Oscars. Kevin Winter/Getty Jessie Buckley is the 2026 Oscar winner for best actress for her powerful performance in Hamnet. "Thank you so much. This is," she said when she arrived onstage before erupting with the giggles. "This is really something." She continued to thank her fellow nominees and everyone involved with the film, "my shipmates." "Mom, dad, thank you for teaching us to dream," she said. To her husband, she added, "You, Fred, I love you man. You’re the most incredible Dad. You’re my best friend, and I want to have 20,000 more babies with you, I do. And Isla, my little girl, who is eight months, who has absolutely no idea what’s going on and is probably dreaming of milk, but this is kind of a big deal, and I love you, and I love being your mom, and I can’t wait to discover life beside you. " "It's Mother's Day in the U.K. today, so I would like to dedicate this to the beautiful chaos of a mother's heart," she added. Michael B. Jordan Is an Oscar Winner! March 15, 2026 10:36 PM EDT Michael B. Jordan wins best actor at the 2026 Oscars. Kevin Winter/Getty Michael B. Jordan has clear eyes, a full heart, and, now, an Oscar. The Sinners star took a moment to look around and take in the standing ovation that erupted when he was announced as this year's best actor. "God is good," he began before shouting out his mom, dad and siblings. He went on to thank director Ryan Coogler: "You’re an amazing, amazing person. I’m so honored to call you a collaborator and a friend, and you gave me opportunity and space for me to be seen. I love you too, bro. Love you to death." He continued by thanking his costars and said, "I stand here because of the people that came before me, Sidney Poitier, Denzel Washington, Halle Berry, Jamie Foxx, Forrest Whitaker, Will Smith. To be amongst those giants, amongst those great, greats, amongst my ancestors, amongst my guys. Thank you, everybody in this room and everybody at home for supporting me over my career. I feel it. I know you guys want me to do well, and I want to do that because you guys bet on me. "So thank you for keeping betting on me, I’m gonna keep stepping up, keep being the best version of myself I can be. So I just want to say thank you to everybody in this room that had something to do with my success. I love you guys." Adrien Brody Mocks Himself March 15, 2026 10:20 PM EDT Adrien Brody at the 2026 Oscars. Kevin Winter/Getty Adrien Brody, who famously gave the longest acceptance speech in Oscars history last year when he won for best actor, didn't hesitate to poke fun at himself as he presented the award this year. He came up to the stage with a stack of papers, made it look like he was going to toss his gum to someone again — but swallowed it instead this time — and was jokingly played off before saying he had something important to say: the nominees' names. Paul Thomas Anderson Wins for Best Directing March 15, 2026 10:18 PM EDT Paul Thomas Anderson wins best director at the 2026 Oscars. Patrick T. Fallon / AFP via Getty One Battle After Another is becoming one win after another. Paul Thomas Anderson won for best director for his work on the film for which he also won best adapted screenplay. "I couldn't ask for a better class," he told his fellow nominees. "It’s an honor to be counted amongst you guys. There will always be some doubt in your heart that you deserve it, but there is, there is no question at the pleasure of having it for myself." "I'm here because of people's faith in me. They give me their faith and their time," Anderson continued. "This is a wonderful gift, and I’m so happy to call the movies home. This is really terrific. Thank you from the bottom of my heart. I love it. " It's Not Just Date Night! March 15, 2026 10:15 PM EDT A bunch of the stars were surrounded by their parents and siblings as they celebrated their work. Michael B. Jordan's mom Donna was there to cheer him on, and Kate Hudson was accompanied by her mom, Goldie Hawn. Timothée Chalamet had his sister Pauline in his corner in addition to his "partner," Kylie Jenner. Michael B. Jordan and Donna Jordan at the 2026 Oscars. John Shearer/98th Oscars/Getty Goldie Hawn and Kate Hudson at the 2026 Oscars. David Fisher/Shutterstock Pauline Chalamet and Timothee Chalamet at the 2026 Oscars. John Shearer/98th Oscars/Getty 'Sentimental Value' Wins One March 15, 2026 10:06 PM EDT Sentimental Value made Norway proud tonight, as the film, which stars Stellan Skarsgard, Renate Reinsve and Elle Fanning, picked up the Oscar for Best International Feature Film. Javier Bardem and Priyanka Chopra Jonas presented the award. A 'Golden' Performance March 15, 2026 10:06 PM EDT KPop Demon Hunters performance at the 2026 Oscars. Patrick T. Fallon / AFP via Getty The entire audience at the Dolby Theatre was illuminated as Huntrix (Rei Ami, Ejae and Audrey Nuna) performed the best song nominee "Golden" from KPop Demon Hunters. On stage, the three voices went up, up, up, and flag dancers kept the action flowing. Soon after, the "Golden" crew was crowned with the best original song Oscar. "Growing up, people made fun of me for liking KPop, but now everyone's singing our song and all the Korean lyrics. I'm so proud," Ejae said "I realize this song is not about success, it's about resilience." A Moment for the Ladies March 15, 2026 09:57 PM EDT Autumn Durald Arkapaw wins best cinematography at the 2026 Oscars. Kevin Winter/Getty After One Battle After Another picked up the win for best editing, Autumn Durald Arkapaw won for best cinematography for her work on Sinners. She is the first woman to ever win in that category. Emotional, she thanked writer and director Ryan Coogler as well as the cast and crew before asking all the women in the room to stand. "I don't get here without you guys. I really, really, truly mean that," she said. "I've felt so much love from all the women on this whole campaign." No One Goes Hungry March 15, 2026 09:41 PM EDT Inside the Dolby Theatre, nominees, presenters and guests were all treated to a special welcome box at their seats, complete with a note from host Conan O'Brien. The 2025 Oscars Snack Box. "Welcome to THE OSCARS!,” it began. “I hope you enjoy this Conan O’Brien ‘Moderately Happy Meal.’ These snacks may not look like much but in any movie theater they would run you $85." He continued, “Good luck tonight, have fun, and remember that loud, enthusiastic laughter is good for your health and my ego.” So what made up that "Moderately Happy Meal"? A bag of Skinny Pop popcorn, a box of Dots candy and a bottle of water. Eagle-eyed TV viewers may have even spotted Jacob Elordi munching on the popcorn. 'Bridesmaids' Reunion Alert! March 15, 2026 09:36 PM EDT Melissa McCarthy, Rose Byrne, Kristen Wiig, Maya Rudolph, and Ellie Kemper at the 2026 Oscars. Kevin Winter/Getty Kristen Wiig, Rose Byrne, Melissa McCarthy, Maya Rudolph and Ellie Kemper came together for a Bridesmaids reunion in order to present the Oscar for best score. The quintet, celebrating the 15th anniversary of the hit film, received notes as Kemper began describing what a score is. "Rose, can you please stop looking at me?" read one for Leonardo DiCaprio. Responded Byrne, "I thought you were somebody else." Two of the notes were supposedly from Stellan Skarsgård commented on how the ladies had aged. "This big could've been a lot shorter," said the one read by Wiig, supposedly written by Benicio del Toro. Kemper's note also referred to the length of the show, especially since it had no pizza. That one was supposedly written by Jacobi Jupe, "the kid from Hamnet." Ultimately, the score from Sinners won the award for best score, and F1 took home the win for Sound. And we won, too, just seeing these five together again. A Gathering of Stars for Rob Reiner, Diane Keaton, Robert Redford and More March 15, 2026 08:49 PM EDT Billy Crystal at the 2026 Oscars. Kevin Winter/Getty Billy Crystal introduced a celebration of Rob Reiner by describing their first encounter in 1975 on the set of All in the Family. Crystal went on to rattle off many of Reiner's most famous and beloved movies. "My friend Rob's movies will last for lifetimes," he said. He continued by talking about Rob's connection with his wife Michelle, and their fight for equality and social justice. "It meant everything to him that his work meant something to you," Crystal said before being joined by the stars of some of those iconic works, including Michael McKean, Christopher Guest, Jerry O'Connell, Wil Wheaton, Fred Savage, Cary Elwes, Mandy Patinkin, Carol Kane, Billy Crystal, Meg Ryan, Kiefer Sutherland, Demi Moore, Kevin Pollak, Kathy Bates, Annette Bening, John Cusack and Daphne Zuniga. Michael McKean, Christopher Guest, Jerry O'Connell, Wil Wheaton, Fred Savage, Cary Elwes, Mandy Patinkin, Carol Kane, Billy Crystal, Meg Ryan, Kiefer Sutherland, Demi Moore, Kevin Pollak, Kathy Bates, Annette Bening, John Cusack and Daphne Zuniga honor Rob Reiner at the 2026 Oscars. Kevin Winter/Getty As the theme from The Princess Bride played, the more of the stars and creators we lost over the past year were honored. Rachel McAdams at the 2026 Oscars. Kevin Winter/Getty Midway through, Rachel McAdams stepped up to the mic to honor Diane Ladd, Catherine O'Hara and the "absolute singularity" that was Diane Keaton. "She meant so much to so many of us," McAdams said of Keaton. "Celebrating a life in silver and gold, a legend with no end." "After I read the first script for The Way We Were, I could only imagine one actor," Barbra Streisand said as she stepped in to celebrate Robert Redford. She went on to share that he turned the movie down at first, but eventually, several drafts later, he changed his tune. "He was a brilliant, subtle actor." She went on to honor the "intellectual cowboy who blazed his own trail," as a director and as a leader in general. "The last note I ever wrote to Bob, I ended it, 'I love you too.' and I signed it, 'Babs.'" She concluded by singing a refrain of "The Way We Were." 'Sinners' Wins Best Original Screenplay March 15, 2026 08:38 PM EDT Ryan Coogler wins for best original screenplay at the 2026 Oscars. Patrick T. Fallon / AFP via Getty Sinners screenwriter (and director) Ryan Coogler won for best original screenplay. It marks the artist's first Oscar win. And the crowd was thrilled, already on their feet before Coogler even reached the stage. "I want to thank everyone that was involved in this movie," he said. "You all are winners in my book." He continued thank his wife, his "babies" and his parents. 'One Battle After Another' Wins Best Adapted Screenplay March 15, 2026 08:34 PM EDT Paul Thomas Anderson wins for best adapted screenplay at the 2026 Oscars. Patrick T. Fallon / AFP via Getty Paul Thomas Anderson scored his first Oscar as One Battle After Another won for Best Adapted Screenplay. The film is inspired by Thomas Pynchon's 1990 novel Vineland. Anderson quickly thanked his partner, Maya Rudolph. Some Scoop from Inside the Theater March 15, 2026 08:34 PM EDT Kylie Jenner and Timothee Chalamet at the 2026 Oscars. Patrick T. Fallon / AFP via Gett And now for some nuggets you're not seeing on TV... When Amy Madigan returned to her seat holding her Oscar, her husband, Ed Harris, didn't realize it at first because he was mid-conversation and facing the other way. Moments later, when he realized Madigan had returned, they shared a kiss and a long hug. Fellow nominees Teyana Taylor and Wunmi Mosaku also shared a long hug during a commercial break. Meanwhile, Kylie Jenner and Timothée Chalamet have been snuggled up and exchanging whispers throughout the night. Sean Penn Wins Best Supporting Actor March 15, 2026 08:22 PM EDT The One Battle After Another actor was not in attendance, so last year's winner, Kieran Culkin, accepted the award on his behalf. The New York Times reports that Penn was in Ukraine. It's an Oscars Tie! March 15, 2026 08:19 PM EDT Kumail Nanjiani had the luck to reveal the winners for best live action short — and it was a tie! He first revealed The Singers won. The producers came onstage to give their acceptance speech. Then Nanjiani stepped back up to the mic and said, "Ironic that the short film Oscar is going to take twice as long." He then revealed the other winner to be Two People Exchanging Saliva. As the second group of filmmakers, including Natalie Musteata and Alexandre Singh, accepted their award, the lights went dark and the microphone began to retract into the stage, an awkward moment host Conan O'Brien called out moments later. This marks only the seventh time there has been a tie in Oscars history. 'One Battle After Another' Wins the First Casting Director Oscar March 15, 2026 08:08 PM EDT Cassandra Kulukundis wins at the 2026 Oscars. Patrick T. Fallon / AFP via Getty To reveal the first winner of the Casting Director Oscar, a star from each of the nominated films took the stage and thanked the nominees. Gwyneth Paltrow appeared for Marty Supreme, Wagner Moura for The Secret Agent, Chase Infiniti for One Battle After Another, Delroy Lindo for Sinners, and Paul Mescal for Hamnet. And Cassandra Kulukundis from One Battle After Another took home the award. Kulukundis went on to honor casting directors who'd never had the opportunity to win an Oscar, as well as those who never even were listed in the credits. She also thanked director Paul Thomas Anderson, whom she's worked with for more than a decade. Anna Wintour Channels Miranda Priestley March 15, 2026 07:57 PM EDT Anna Wintour and Anne Hathaway at the 2026 Oscars. Patrick T. Fallon / AFP via Getty In a truly meta moment, Vogue icon Anna Wintour and The Devil Wears Prada and The Devil Wears Prada 2 star Anne Hathaway presented the awards for costume design and achievement in hair and makeup. First, Wintour seemingly dissed Hathaway when the actress asked the fashion expert for her response to her look for the evening, not answering and instead listing the nominees. For the second award, Wintour quipped, "Thank you, Emily," to Hathaway, referencing Miranda calling all of her assistants "Emily." So, yeah, Wintour is in on the joke now for the sequel, coming in May. The Juke Joint Gets a Standing Ovation March 15, 2026 07:47 PM EDT Misty Copeland performs at the 2026 Oscars. Robert Gauthier / Los Angeles Times via Getty A special performance of "I Lied To You" from Sinners by Raphael Saadiq and Ludwig Goransson featured many of the hit movie's cast members, including Miles Caton, as well as Shaboozy and an appearance by Misty Copeland. Copeland took her final bow with American Ballet Theatre in October 2025, marking an end to her 25-year career with the company. This marks her first public performance since undergoing hip replacement surgery in December. The crowd went wild when she arrived onstage, and gave the whole performance a standing ovation. And, yes, Timothée Chalamet was among the audience members on their feet. Sinners has a record 16 nominations. KPop Demon Hunters Wins Best Animated Feature March 15, 2026 07:38 PM EDT KPop Demon Hunters. Netflix They were already up, up, up, but now they're truly golden. "This is for Korea, and for Koreans everywhere," said executive producer Michelle Wong. Right after, The Girl Who Cried Pearls won best animated short. Anyone Else Feeling Inspired? March 15, 2026 07:31 PM EDT It's easy to get jaded during awards season. O'Brien did a beautiful job putting the Oscars in perspective during his opening monologue, and I want to give the moment its due. "If I can be serious for just a moment, everyone watching right now, around the world, is all too aware that these are very chaotic, frightening times. Okay? It’s at moments like these that I believe that the Oscars are particularly resonant. Check it out: 31 countries across six continents are represented this evening. And every film, every film we salute, is the product of thousands of people speaking different languages, working hard to make something of beauty. "We pay tribute tonight, not just to film, but to the ideals of global artistry, collaboration, patience, resilience and that rarest of qualities today, optimism. So let us please celebrate. Let us celebrate not because we think all is well, but because we work and hope for better." Movies and even awards shows bring people together. (I mean, so does ballet and opera. Sorry. Too easy.) Amy Madigan Wins Best Supporting Actress March 15, 2026 07:26 PM EDT Amy Madigan wins best supporting actress at the 2026 Oscars. Patrick T. Fallon / AFP via Getty If you give a terrific performance, an Oscar will come. Field of Dreams alum Amy Madigan won best supporting actress for her role as Aunt Gladys in Weapons. "This is great!" Madigan began. Referring to winning 40 years after her last Oscar nomination, which was also her first, she said, "What's different is I got this little gold guy! I was in the shower last night trying to think of something to say as I was shaving my legs, and I've got pants on, I don’t have to worry about that." "As you can tell, I'm a little flummoxed. ... My legs are shaking," she continued, and went on to thank her fellow nominees. She concluded, "Most important, I want to thank my Ed, who's been with me for a long, long time." It Only Took 5 Minutes... March 15, 2026 07:14 PM EDT Timothee Chalamet at the 2026 Oscars. ANGELA WEISS / AFP via Getty Among O'Brien's first comments was a joke about Timothée Chalamet's controversial comments about opera and ballet. "Security is extremely tight tonight. Just got to mention that, yeah, I’m told there’s concern about attacks from both the opera and ballet communities," O'Brien quipped as the cameras zoomed in on Chalamet and his date, Kylie Jenner. "They're just mad you left out jazz." That'll be the first of many references, count on it. Conan O'Brien Opens the Show on the Run March 15, 2026 07:08 PM EDT Conan O'Brien at the 2026 Oscars. Patrick T. Fallon / AFP via Getty Conan O'Brien opened the show as Aunt Gladys, Amy Madigan's character from Weapons. After being chased by a bunch of kids, he wound up battling Marty Supreme in ping-pong, running across the stage from Hamnet, and hitching a ride with Benicio del Toro in One Battle After Another. Then he got animated and locked eyes with Huntrix in KPop Demon Hunters and spoke with Stellan Skarsgård in Sentimental Value. After trying to get into the juke joint in Sinners, he wound up running through the red carpet and onto the Oscars stage — though magically transformed back into the beloved comedian. "Big thanks to Amy Madigan for the wig," he said before joking he would be "the last human host of the Academy Awards." Dream Dates! March 15, 2026 06:59 PM EDT Before the show begins, we have to take a moment for some of the other gorgeous couples hitting the carpets, from newer duos to pairs who've been married for decades. Ed Harris and Amy Madigan at the 2026 Oscars. Arturo Holmes/Getty Paul Mescal and Gracie Abrams. David Fisher/Shutterstock Ben Falcone and Melissa McCarthy at the 2026 Oscars. Kevin Mazur/Getty From Reality TV to Oscar Nominations March 15, 2026 06:35 PM EDT Emma Stone and Jessie Buckley at the 2026 Oscars. Getty (2) Did you know that two of the five stars nominated for Best Actress started their careers on reality TV? Emma Stone, nominated for Bugonia, began her career as a contestant on In Search of the Partridge Family in 2004 on VH1. And Jessie Buckley, nominated for Hamnet, was on 2008's BBC series I'd Do Anything when she was 17. So who's next? Hit me up in the comments and tell me which reality star needs to go scripted. Last Year's Nominees Are WINNING March 15, 2026 06:27 PM EDT Is Demi Moore even real?! The actress looks incredible in a feathered custom Gucci number. Last year's best supporting actress winner, Zoe Saldaña, is crushing a look from Saint Laurent by Anthony Vaccarello. And the jewels! My goodness. Zoe Saldana at the 2026 Oscars. Once Upon a Time... March 15, 2026 06:19 PM EDT Josh Dallas and Ginnifer Goodwin at the 2026 Oscars. Mike Coppola/Getty Today is truly a fairy tale for Once Upon a Time fans! Ginnifer Goodwin, who voices a character in the best animated feature-nominated Zootopia 2, brought a date to the Oscars, her former costar and husband of nearly 12 years, Josh Dallas. The Key to This Look... March 15, 2026 06:16 PM EDT Kylie Jenner teased her sexy "Jessica Rabbit" look on Instagram, and it appears she thinks her man, Timothée Chalamet, is a lock for best actor for his performance in Marty Supreme. "Jessica who?" the star wrote on Instagram showing off her red-hot Schiaparelli look with a keyhole-shaped keyhole. Jenner tagged the designer and its creative director Daniel Roseberry as well as and jeweler Lorraine Schwartz. "My heart skipped a beat," her sister Khloé Kardashian wrote in the comments. Much Ado About Domhnall Gleeson's Bucket List March 15, 2026 06:06 PM EDT Domhnall Gleeson and Taylor Swift in her 'Opalite' music video. Taylor Swift/Apple Music Gleeson told E! that appearing in Taylor Swift's music video for "Opalite" was a bucket list item he didn't know to put on his bucket list. "I’m 42, I’ve got no business being in a Taylor Swift music video, so it was incredibly exciting," he told E!. "There was something special about doing a dance number with Taylor. That was not on my bucket list. I didn’t realize that was on my bucket list until it happened." Gleeson's film Retirement Plan is nominated for best animated short tonight. The Red Carpet Is on Fire March 15, 2026 05:53 PM EDT The stars are really bringing it tonight. Don't miss a single look and click through our red carpet gallery! Chase Infiniti at the 2026 Oscars. ANGELA WEISS / AFP via Getty It Happens Every Year March 15, 2026 05:45 PM EDT Adrien Brody, Mikey Madison, Zoe Saldana and Kieran Culkin at the 2025 Oscars. Jeff Kravitz/FilmMagic Maybe it's just me, but I suspect it's not: You're gearing up to watch the Oscars, and you're so excited, and then you realize, for all that excitement, you can't, for the life of you, remember what won last year. Quick recap, just because we'll be seeing these stars again this year: Anora took home best picture, and its star, Mikey Madison, won best actress. Adrien Brody won best actor for The Brutalist and gave the longest acceptance speech ever (literally). Supporting actor and actress went to Kieran Culkin for A Real Pain and Zoe Saldaña for Emilia Perez. You're welcome. We Love a Reunion March 15, 2026 05:38 PM EDT Rose Byrne and Bobby Cannavale are having a super fancy date night in honor of Byrne's best actress nomination for If I Had Legs I'd Kick You , but did you catch her red carpet reunion with her Peter Rabbit costar Domhnall Gleeson? We sure didn't. Check out their sweet moment here: Kevin O'Leary Put His Money Where His Costar Is March 15, 2026 05:32 PM EDT Shark Tank's Kevin O'Leary, who starred in Marty Supreme, told Variety and CNN that he's betting on his costar Timothée Chalamet to win Best Actor. "I just put $1,000 on Kalshi walking in here that he's going to win because I know the voting stopped long before that controversy happened," he said. "That kid is a great kid." O'Leary also defended Chalamet amid the backlash that followed his comments about opera and ballet. "He took a bum rap on that," O'Leary said, noting that the whole thing ultimately "gave a lot of promo to opera and ballet." KPop Girl Dad March 15, 2026 05:20 PM EDT Ken Jeong at the 2026 Oscars. Frazer Harrison/WireImage) "I basically played it like a girl dad," Ken Jeung tells E! of his manager character in KPop Demon Hunters. "Bobby treated Huntrix as his kids, just unconditional love and support. It's probably, in many ways, the most accurate character I've ever played, so it's kind of ironic that it would be in this animated juggernaut." The actor himself shares twin daughters Zooey and Alexa, born in 2007, with his wife, Tran Ho. A Princess Moment March 15, 2026 05:09 PM EDT Can we take a moment for Mckenna Grace? Remember when she played young Tonya Harding in I, Tonya? That was 2016. Now, she's starring in Scream 7 and leading the next Hunger Games movie, Sunrise on the Reaping. The 19-year-old is showing she's every bit deserving of a princess moment in this stunning pink gown. Arturo Holmes/Getty The Oscars Are Already Heated March 15, 2026 04:58 PM EDT Hudson Williams at the 2026 Oscars. Frazer Harrison/WireImage Heated Rivalry has entered the building! Star Hudson Williams is one of the early arrivals for the big night. The actor is rocking a black Balenciaga double-breasted jacket and suit pants with shiny, pointy-toed shoes, a diamond brooch, a silver cuff and small silver hoop earrings. The actor will be returning to the Heated Rivalry set August; season 2 is expected in April 2027 on HBO Max. In the meantime, he told E! he's hoping to meet director Yorgos Lanthimos tonight. Have Some Tissues Ready March 15, 2026 04:50 PM EDT Consider yourself warned. With so many heartbreaking celebrity deaths over the past year, expect tributes and the In Memoriam segment to be especially heartbreaking this year. Host Conan O'Brien revealed to Extra that Rob Reiner will be honored — and many stars who worked with him over the years like Billy Crystal, Meg Ryan and Jerry O'Connell are rumored to appear. "It's going to be a very powerful part of the show," he said. During a press conference on Wednesday, March 11, Oscars producers Raj Kapoor and Katy Mullan said the "in memoriam" segment will be longer than usual. "We really hope that it is a tribute that moves people and feels like it does the incredible people we've lost this year justice," Mullan explained.
